subject: Cognitive Science
title: Network Effects
description: A fast breakdown of Network Effects for builders.

hook.text: The first fax machine was useless. The second made both valuable. By a million, they changed business.

buildup.text: A network effect means a product gets more valuable as more people use it. Value grows with adoption.

discovery.text: Metcalfe's law says a network's value scales with the square of its users. Two people: one link. Ten: forty-five.

twist.text: Network effects create winner-take-all markets. Once a network leads, it's nearly impossible to overtake.

climax.text: Facebook, Uber, and Airbnb all won through network effects, not through better technology alone.

punchline.text: Value isn't in the product. It's in the network.

quiz.question: What is a network effect?
options: A product becomes more valuable as more people use it
Networks always lose value over time
